    [edit]

    Format

    [edit]
    • Group Stage: May 27th - June 16th
      • Round Robin
      • All matches are Ft3
      • 2 Groups
      • Top 2 teams of each group advance to Playoffs
    • Playoffs: June 23th
      • Single Elimination
      • All matches (excl. Grand Finals) are Ft2
      • Grand Finals are Ft3
